props.doc: Blend each route from its origin's colour to its destination's, in Oklab (with `colors`). Default false.

props.name: land
props.doc: The land dots' colour, and the names'. Default `#ffffff`.

props.name: landOpacity
props.doc: The land dots' opacity. Default 0.18.

props.name: pitch
props.doc: Space between land dots, CSS px. Default 7.

props.name: dot
props.doc: A land dot's radius, CSS px. Default 1.4.

props.name: dotShape
props.doc: The land dots' shape: `round` or `square`. Default `round`.

props.name: graticule
props.doc: Faint lines of latitude and longitude, in dots: true for every 30°, or the degrees between them. Default false.

props.name: region
props.doc: What the map shows: `world`, `europe`, `north-america`, `south-america`, `africa`, `middle-east`, `asia`, `oceania`, `routes` (fitted round the cities and the arcs between them), or [[south, west], [north, east]]. Default `world`.

props.name: fit
props.doc: `contain` shows all of the region; `cover` fills the box with it. Default `contain`.

props.name: drift
props.doc: Pan the map east this many degrees a second (negative for west), round and round the world. Default 0.

props.name: lap
props.doc: Seconds a comet takes along a route. Default 3.2.

props.name: lift
props.doc: How high the arcs bow, a share of their length. Default 0.3, or 0.08 with a great-circle `curve`.

props.name: curve
props.doc: `bow`: arcs bow up between the cities. `great-circle`: they follow the shortest way over the globe, over the date line where that is shorter. Default `bow`.

props.name: arcOpacity
props.doc: The faint arcs' opacity. Default 0.14.

props.name: dashed
props.doc: Dash the faint arcs, the dashes running from origin to destination. Default false.

props.name: width
props.doc: The comets' width, CSS px; the faint arcs are a line half as wide. Default 2.2.

props.name: tail
props.doc: A comet's length, a share of its route. Default 0.28.

props.name: glow
props.doc: The glow round a comet's head, CSS px; 0 for none. Default 10.

props.name: comets
props.doc: Comets on each route at once. Default 1.

props.name: ping
props.doc: How wide the ring a landing comet opens grows, CSS px; 0 for none. Default 17.

props.name: markers
props.doc: Mark the cities with a dot. Default true.

props.name: markerSize
props.doc: A city dot's radius, CSS px. Default 2.2.

props.name: halo
props.doc: A soft halo breathing round every city (the home city always has one). Default false.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Name the cities, leaving out names that would overlap (hovering a city names it either way). Default false.

props.name: font
props.doc: The names' CSS font. Default `500 11px system-ui, sans-serif`.

props.name: interactive
props.doc: Hovering a city or a route (not through a link or button) brightens it and names it. Default true.

props.name: fixed
props.doc: Fill the viewport, behind the page (position: fixed, z-index -1). Default false.

props.name: fade
props.doc: Fade the edges out, for a cropped map: true for the left and right, or 'top', 'bottom' or 'both'. Default false.

props.name: class
props.doc: Classes for the element.
